title: pytest Beyond the Basics

lessons.title: Mocking External Dependencies

lessons.description: Cover many cases with one readable test.
learningObjectives: Parametrize over inputs and expected outputs
Name parametrized cases for readable failures

lessons.title: Coverage and CI
lessons.description: Measure coverage honestly and wire tests into automation.
learningObjectives: Generate and read a coverage report
Run pytest in a CI pipeline
